record.title: Administrative Specialist I
record.deadlineLabel: Nov 3, 2026 · 5 PM · Maryland local time assumed
record.reviewer: Codex source-backed review; not independent HR validation · Full official announcement and HTTPS identity/excerpts inspected

requirements.label: High-school credential or equivalency
requirements.summary: Accredited high-school graduation or equivalency; a generic certificate does not establish this.

requirements.label: Administrative experience or a published substitution
requirements.exact: Six months of experience performing administrative staff, clerical, clerical technical, or secretarial work.
requirements.summary: Six qualifying months; 30 accredited college credits may substitute. Military equivalence requires review.

requirements.label: Work authorization and other conditions
requirements.summary: Legal work authorization, possible driving duties and foreign-credential review need checking with HR.

preferred: Office tools, customer service, regulatory explanations, financial-data tracking and careful information handling (summary).
substitutions: 30 accredited college credits replace the required administrative experience.
Qualifying military staff experience can substitute under the bulletin’s stated equivalence; ask HR.
record.restrictions: Work authorization required; driving and credential evaluation may apply. Do not enter sensitive records here.
materials: Complete state application and supplemental questionnaire; a résumé alone is insufficient.
record.limitations: Selected criteria only, checked against the full bulletin. Timezone assumed. Employer may withdraw early. No independent HR review.
record.summary: Baltimore environmental registration support and public inquiries. Check the experience or college-credit route.
record.qualificationSummary: Six qualifying administrative months OR 30 accredited college credits; military substitution has published conditions. No eligibility certification.
